description: Email authentication check for a domain. Returns the SPF record with its DNS lookup count and all qualifier, the DMARC policy and report addresses, MX hosts, MTA-STS and BIMI records, DKIM keys found on common selectors, a grade from A to F and a list of issues. Use to diagnose deliverability or spoofing risk. DKIM is checked on common selectors only. Typical response under 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).
name: quantagentshop_email_auth_check
title: Email auth check
